      - name: Checkout repository

          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: dev
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Merge dev into features/hubs-recs

          git fetch origin features/hubs-recs
          git checkout features/hubs-recs
          git fetch origin dev
          git merge --no-ff origin/dev -m "Merge dev into features/hubs-recs"
          git push origin features/hubs-recs

      - name: Build features/hubs-recs

          pwsh -Command "./build.ps1"
